subject: HealthTech go-live: MAP rebaseline request & risk ledger
messages:
From: Joanne Li <joanne.li@healthtech.co>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@healthtech.co>
Date: 2028-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HealthTech MAP: final procurement gating and go-live target

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Monday. We finished our internal security review this morning and there are two outstanding items (data retention policy confirmation + SOC evidence for encrypted backups) that will require an extra procurement review. Procurement is estimating +2 weeks for approval after those docs are in.

We still want to go live in June if possible, but we need Redwood's help to:
- Provide a short risk log that procurement can attach to their packet (one page)
- Confirm the final MAP milestones and an alternate go-live window if approval slips

I attached the security summary that triggered the hold (HealthTech_Security_SIR.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a conditional PO with a 30-day remediation SLA or if you require all items closed pre-PO?

Thanks — Joanne
Director, Program Management
HealthTech Solutions

Attachment: HealthTech_Security_SIR.pdf (pdf, 1 page summary)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Joanne Li <joanne.li@healthtech.co>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@healthtech.co>
Date: 2028-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthTech MAP: final procurement gating and go-live target

Joanne —

Appreciate the heads up and the SIR. We can support a conditional PO path while procurement completes their review provided we capture the risk and remediation steps in a short risk ledger and agree on rollback/fallback conditions. Draft summary below — I can turn this into a one-page PDF and the MAP spreadsheet by EOD Tuesday.

Redwood proposed risk summary (draft):
- Risk: Delayed procurement approval for backup encryption evidence.
  - Impact: Possible push of go-live window by ~14 days; feature gating for audit logs export until evidence provided.
  - Mitigation: Redwood to provide temporary redaction and limited export controls; commit to restoration within 30 days of PO.
- Risk: Outstanding SOC evidence (backup encryption).
  - Impact: Procurement may require pre-closure.
  - Mitigation: Provide notarized attestation + staged deliverable (attestation now, full evidence within 10 business days after PO).

Proposed MAP rebaseline (if hold persists):
- Current target: 2028-06-15 go-live
- Rebaseline window A: 2028-06-29 (preferred conservative)
- Rebaseline window B: 2028-07-06 (if procurement requires extended review)

Next steps (asks for HealthTech):
1) Confirm whether Procurement will accept a conditional PO attached to the one-page risk ledger (we can provide language).
2) Confirm a preferred rebaseline window (A or B above).
3) Provide any additional compliance contacts so we can fast-track the attestation.

I attached the working MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) and will produce a concise risk ledger (one page) for Procurement. If we get Procurement's conditional PO language, we can circulate it to legal and DocuSign right away.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 4 tabs)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-24T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthTech MAP: final procurement gating and go-live target

Kim —

Thanks for the draft. Quick notes:
- I'll reach out to my counterpart in procurement to ask whether they will accept a conditional PO with remedial SLA. If they push for pre-closure we should be ready to offer the staged attestation path.
- Laura, can you prepare the customer success-side runbook for the 30-day remediation offer (who owns the remediation tasks, rollback plan, and customer notification cadence)? We should include a short statement about controlled exports and KV cache isolation for the audit window.

I'll escalate to the procurement contact if we don't have a yes/no by Friday.

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Joanne Li <joanne.li@healthtech.co>, Procurement <procurement@healthtech.co>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: HealthTech MAP risk ledger + PO routing (formal)

Joanne / Procurement team —

Per our internal alignment, attached is the formal risk ledger and the proposed conditional-language for a PO (HT_MAP_RiskLog_20280529.csv and Redwood_PO_Template_v1.docx). Key points up front:

- Redwood can accept a conditional PO tied to a 30-day remediation SLA for the two outstanding items (backup encryption evidence + data retention confirmation).
- We will provide an attestation within 2 business days and full SOC backup evidence within 10 business days after PO signature.
- If remediation is not completed within 30 days, Redwood will enable a controlled rollback and preserve historical logs for audit for an additional 30 days while we remediate in an escalation lane.

Risk ledger summary (high level):
- Likelihood: Medium
- Business impact: Potential 2-week go-live delay; limited export functionality for audit window
- Mitigation: Staged attestation + temporary export controls + Canary fallback to earlier model variant with KV isolation

We propose the rebaseline window of 2028-06-29 to account for procurement throughput. If Procurement confirms acceptance of the conditional PO, we can push DocuSign today and retain the 2028-06-15 window as contingency.

Attachments: HT_MAP_RiskLog_20280529.csv (csv), Redwood_PO_Template_v1.docx (docx)

Related links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HT-2028-0427
DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-HT-0427

Please confirm next steps and whether Procurement will issue the conditional PO language so Legal can review.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
